{{SameName|Hallow Guard|[[Hallow Guard (Trick or Threat Town)|Trick or Threat Town]] • [[Hallow Guard (Lunar Overture)|Lunar Overture]] • [[Hallow Guard (Null & Void)|Null & Void]] • [[Hallow Guard (Unit)|Unit]]}} {{EventSandboxOnly|date = 8th of May 2021|event = [[Halloween 2020 Event]]}} {{For|the [[Hallow Bones]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Hallow Guard |image1 = HallowGuard.png |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] via [[Logbooks]] ---- Originally:
[[Halloween 2020 Event|Halloween 2020]] |first_wave_appearance = 17 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]10,000 |defense = {{Defense}}35% |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slow (1.5) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Slash}}''' - Attacks towers with its sword, stunning them for a while. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Hallow Guard''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[Trick or Threat Town]], and was the first enemy to spawn, as part of the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, It also has 35% defense which means that the '''Hallow Guard''' may take a while to defeat. Additionally, it can stun towers with its ''Slash'' ability. ==Appearance== The '''Hallow Guard''' is very similar to the [[Hallow Bones]], except that it is much taller than it. It is entirely made out of marble dark grey parts to represent a skeleton. It does not have a full torso, but instead has the bone cage for it. Its head is slightly smaller than usual and has two large yellow eyes. Fire is emitted from its eyes. It has dark marble armor and helmet. It holds a sword which is used to slash at towers. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Trick or Threat Town]] during its event is listed instead. *Due to their high health and defense, the [[Ranger]] is the best tower against the '''Hallow Guard'''. **Placing down multiple Level 3+ [[Ranger]]s is recommended to take down this enemy. **The [[Accelerator]] and [[Turret]] can also be used. ***Be aware that if the [[Accelerator]] is stunned, it will have to go through its lengthy charge-up again. **The [[Minigunner]] can also be used, but due to the '''Hallow Guard's''' defense, it will only deal half damage towards it. ***You can lower the '''Hallow Guard's''' defense by using the [[Pyromancer]], [[Freezer]] or [[Electroshocker]]. *If you can, try to place towers away from the path so that they cannot be targeted by the '''Hallow Guard'''. **Cliff and air-based towers cannot be targeted, making them ideal against the '''Hallow Guard'''. *Using the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability to boost the firerate of towers attacking this enemy is a good idea. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyHallowGuard.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (9 November 2025 – Present) CorpseLegacyHallowGuardNoAnim.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, no animation version (31 October 2025 – 9 November 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} LegacyHallowGuardNoAnimation.png|First version, broken animation (31 October 2025 – 9 November 2025) HallowGuard.png|First version (31 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyHallowGuardIconIG.png|'''Hallow Guard''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Hallow Guard''' had a death animation where it would fall into a pile of bones and its head would roll a short distance. *When the '''Hallow Guard''' was first added, its death animation did not play correctly. **Instead it just stood still. This prevented [[units]] from getting past it. *The '''Hallow Guard''' may be a reference to the [https://minecraft.wiki/w/Wither_Skeleton Wither Skeleton] from ''Minecraft''. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.1|Overhaul v1.1.0]] **'''Hallow Guard''' added. **{{Bug}} Death animation does not play; instead it stands still. *'''23 November 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.1|Overhaul v1.1.1]] **Health increased from 8,000 to 10,000. **{{Bugfix}} Death animation now works properly. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Hallow Guard''' removed. *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **'''Hallow Guard''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Hallow Guard (Null & Void)|Hallow Guard]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Null & Void Event]]. **{{Bug}} No longer has any animations. **{{Bug}} Ability no longer works. *'''9 November 2025''' - [[v1.79.0|v1.79.1a]] **{{Bugfix}} Now has a walking animation. {{TrickTown|[[Vampire (Trick or Threat Town)|Vampire]]|Wave 16|Hallow Guard|Wave 17|[[Lord Sinister]]|Wave 18}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Hallow Guard}}
